card.name: Digits and commas inside numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits, commas or letters in the middle of a number or short abbreviation, such as the comma in 52,000 or the 3 in 2,38. It also fires on the 'g' in e,g. and the end of a web domain.

modes.label: Inside a number
modes.description: A digit or comma partway through a written number, usually with a comma as thousands or decimal separator.

modes.label: Comma in a reference or list
modes.description: A comma between numbers in a section cross-reference or in an abbreviation.

modes.label: Odd punctuation or domain text
modes.description: The 'g' of a mistyped e.g. or the org of a website path.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted or suppressed tokens, which are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It activates in the middle of a number, on a digit or comma, before the number is finished.
